placements.why: The envelope's content is fundamentally about instrument calibration: the frequency chosen, the reference plates used for verification, and the assertion that calibration holds across the observing band. No existing strata category covers this; Calibration is the organizational home for calibration-state decisions.
placements.title: Instrument calibration as a first-class organizational concern
placements.theme: Calibration decisions — frequency, reference verification, and instrument readiness — are tracked as organizational knowledge.

placements.title: Spectrograph calibration verified against reference plates across the full observing band
placements.theme: The Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz is established and verified against June reference plates, holding across the full observing band.
placements.why: Both segments express the same thematic content: Quill's witness testimony (src-1) and the recorded decision summary (src-2) establish that the Kestrelwood spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz and verified against June reference plates. This is a directional statement about instrument readiness that future envelopes could continue to feed — subsequent calibration checks, drift observations, or re-verification events would all support this leaf. No existing leaf holds this theme.
